title: Cheeger constant rigidity for cocompact negatively curved manifolds
summary: Let $(M^m,g)$, $m\geq2$, be a closed connected Riemannian manifold with $\secg_g\leq-1$, and let $(X,g_X)$ be its universal cover. Yau proved that $\hiso(X)\geq m-1$. We prove that equality is rigid: if $\hiso(X)=m-1$, then $(X,g_X)$ is isometric to $\Hh^m(-1)$.
